reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Matched wild-type versus kinase-dead K rescue in K-loss cells; proposed orthogonal confirmation assessed where used.

checks.reason: No explicit prior Methods/supplement/validated-protocol consultation and detailed condition-transfer verification before execution.
No matched non-targeting editing/selection control for the genetic route. Parental cells and null rescue conditions do not isolate the common editing procedure.

checks.quote: Neither tested function is sufficient/necessary alone
checks.reason: In the table where both validated KD and catalytically active scaffold-deficient K rescue, saying neither function is sufficient is reversed: each retained functional route is sufficient in that experiment, while neither tested function is individually necessary.

The packet is treated as establishing K necessity before on-target attribution. The proposed K plus S-immunoprecipitate experiment is also called a directness test without excluding coprecipitating kinases; co-complex phosphorylation does not establish direct K-to-S transfer.
No cancer-line identity, mycoplasma or passage integrity gate despite useful K-locus/construct checks.
No actual delivery dose, cell number, exposure/expression duration and conditioning recipe or concrete bounded calibration setting these quantities.

checks.quote: Use only signals within the linear range
checks.reason: Linearity is named but no specific phospho-assay reference/blank accuracy gate or interference-validation procedure and failure criterion are provided.

Phospho/total and ligand/no-ligand ratios and the rescue index have no explicit background/below-limit or missing-measurement handling; WT rescue near the detection floor can produce an unstable index.

Passage of a shared clone is not independent genotype derivation. Fixed minimum replicate numbers and an equivalence-margin pilot do not supply the required independent-unit sample-size/precision calculation.

checks.quote: increase n or improve assay sensitivity
checks.reason: Increasing sample size after observing a below-threshold growth effect is outcome-dependent sampling without a prespecified sequential boundary or maximum; genuine small/null effects must be retained.
S is only a pathway readout and need not bind K. Requiring K-S co-IP to validate scaffolding can reject a fully competent indirect-signaling kinase; partner identity must first be established.

checks.quote: log-spaced range around the expected active dose
checks.reason: Neither the expected range nor bounds/range derivation and a lock are defined. EC50 or saturating dose remains an unresolved choice with different sensitivity to partial rescue.
No refrozen repaired protocol and fresh independent confirmation after mutation, promoter, dose or background changes.

Ten percent of WT may fully support signaling. The KD acceptance gate does not relate residual activity to the minimum activity capable of rescue, invalidating the dispensability rule; absence of significant KD-EV difference is also not a no-rescue bound.

Orthogonal inhibitor is named without operational cellular target-engagement, null/resistance or scaffold-preservation validation; reciprocal mutants are proposed without a complete independent validation route.
No sample/raw-file/model/code/settings provenance trail.

Useful mutation/folding/localization QC, randomized coded plate design, mixed models, equivalence intervals and Holm control. Troubleshooting is specific and phenotype death/proliferation alternatives are recognized. One reciprocal-rescue table is logically reversed; residual-activity qualification and independent validation remain insufficient. G3/G4 consequences are not charged again beyond P09/P13/P14.
